title: Custom eggless cakes, pickup until 10pm — Harris Park, Rosehill and Camellia
summary:
Most cake shops close before you clock off. Harris Park doesn't — open until 10pm, every day of the week.

That matters when a Rosehill or Camellia order needs picking up after a full shift, not squeezed into a lunch break. Every cake is 100% eggless — not some, all of them — across 15 flavours and six sizes, finished in buttercream, fondant or ganache. Any design, from a photo reference.

48 hours minimum notice. Fresh doesn't happen on demand.

WhatsApp +61 425 697 725 to lock in your size, flavour and pickup time. Hindi and Gujarati spoken in-store.
